full_judgment: 2. Brief fact are that the opposite party Nos. 1, 2 and 3, as plaintiffs, instituted the above Other Suit No. 4 of 1995 praying for declaration of their joint right, title and interest in the suit plot stating inter alia that 1.781/2 acres of land under C.S. Khatian No. 94 and R.O.R. Khatian No. 191 Mauza Chardaga, P.S. Melandah, District Jamalpur, belonged to Baben Sheikh (IV 82). Gol Mamud (IV 82) and Rahmat Ali (V.02) and Gol Mahmud died leaving Nawab Ali the plaintiff No. 1, Tayab Ali, Rahmat Ali, the defendant No. 5 Baban Ali died leaving behind his son Jaban Ali and daughters gendy, Jamury and wife Rupjan Beoya, Rupjan Beoya gifted her share i.e. 54 ½ decimals of land to Samsul Haque, Jamury died leaving behind his son Velu, defendant No. 3, Gendy transferred 90 decimals of land to Jaban Ali by registered Sale deed Gul Mahmud during his life time sold 90 decimals of land to Jaban Ali. Thus Jaban Ali became owner of 3.73 acres of land out of which he sold 28 decimals of land to Meen, Gias, Reza and Maruddin and at the time of possessing and enjoining the balance 3.45 acres of land the aforesaid, Jaban Ali died leaving behind his 3 sons Bisu, Gafur and Gias the defendant No. 1, daughters Urmeli the plaintiff No. 2, Kholeli the plaintiff No. 3 and wife Jariman, Bisu and Gafur died an bachelor teaming behind mother Jariman brother, Gias defendant No. 1, and sister Urmeli and Koheli, i.e. plaintiff Nos. 2-3 Jariman gifted her 52 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 2-3 by registered deed of hiba Jariman Ali died leaving behind his son defendant No. 1 and two daughters plaintiff Nos. 2-3. Then three brothers Bisu, Gafur and Gias and the plaintiff Nos. 2-3, by family partition obtained 43 decimals of land from Dag No. 31.7 ½  decimals of land from Dag No. 136, 79 decimals of land from Dag No. 174 and 43 decimals of land from Dag No. 176. There Gias, the defendant No. 1 them sold 1234 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 1 and the defendant No. 5 by registered deed No. 17610 dated 26.12.70. The plaintiff No. 2 transferred 50 decimals of land to the plaintiff No. 1 by registered deed No. 447 dated 13.1.88 and thus the plaintiffs are possessing and enjoining 1.78 decimals of land but during R.O.R. operation, the name of the plaintiffs No. 2 and 3 were excluded and the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 1 and his mother Jariman and hence plaintiffs instituted the instant suit.
